acceptanceCriteria.text: The Repository is added via the OWNED ACTION ModelLayer.addRepository (mints through the create seam: owner set, IOR composed, registered in mof-m1) — NEVER a hand-written Repository unit. A hand-write bypassing the action => RED.

gateRef.assertion: a hand-written Repository bypassing ModelLayer.addRepository => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: hand-write a Repository unit bypassing the action -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: ONE selector — the reused rb-diff-editor RepoRefSelector (extended project + new-project). grep 0 second repo/branch picker. A forked picker => RED.

gateRef.assertion: grep finds exactly one repo/branch picker (the reused one); a 2nd forked picker => RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: gh calls ONLY in RepoRegistry (the EXISTING gh boundary — REUSED, not a 2nd GhBoundary). grep 0 inline gh in views or domain methods. Repository.create/Project.create DELEGATE to RepoRegistry. An inline gh call outside RepoRegistry => RED.

gateRef.assertion: grep 0 inline gh outside RepoRegistry; inline gh in a view/domain method => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: inline a gh call in a view or domain method -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: CREATE (new repo/new project) defaults PRIVATE + requires an EXPLICIT create-intent flag; happens at BUILD on Tron's explicit go (never a side effect, never an architect step). A public or no-confirm create => RED. (public publishes everything + delete does not unpublish = irreversible.)

gateRef.assertion: GhBoundary.createRepo/createProject default PRIVATE + require explicit create-intent; a public/no-confirm create => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: create a repo/project public or without explicit create-intent -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: New Repository/Project units carry ownerIor=Tron + fully-qualified IOR. A null-owner or bare-IOR new unit => RED.

gateRef.assertion: new Repository/Project have ownerIor=Tron + FQ-IOR; null-owner/bare-IOR => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: mint a new Repository/Project with null owner or bare IOR -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: SELECT/ATTACH an EXISTING repo/project performs NO outward create (read/attach only, not gated). Only the NEW branches hit the gated create. An existing-attach that fires an outward gh create => RED.

gateRef.assertion: attaching an existing repo/project makes no outward gh create; an existing-attach with an outward create => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: make existing-attach fire an outward gh create -> RED
